associations.rationale: This implication relates dominance to LexLe, a consequence involving another order, rather than giving the source's first-differing-part definition.
The type only exposes LexLe as an opaque binary proposition and does not display the lexicographic comparison defined in the source.
Nat.Partition.LexLt is the named strict lexicographic relation introduced by the source, so this declaration directly formalizes that definition and is primary.
The non-dominance implication is a consequence of lexicographic comparison and does not state the definition introduced by the source.
Existence of some lexicographically ordered pair is merely a consequence and leaves the ordering criterion opaque.
